SEB

Go to Artists page
Real name
Sébastien Pèllerin
Country
France

Sébastien Pèllerin was born in 1976. His musical journey began in 1995 in Angers, where he met artists and producers like Fabio Jelly Head and Julien Digital Talk. In 1998, Sébastien's journey led him to the idyllic shores of St Martin in the Antilles, where he DJed and orchestrated unforgettable parties. By 2001, he found himself on Reunion Island, continuing to infuse the local music scene with his vibrant energy.

Around this time, Seb discovered India, a country whose cultural and musical influences captivated him. Frequent travels to India, especially Goa, led to a creative partnership with Arjuna (Parvati Rec), resulting in several collaborated tracks and the joint project Nomad Soul. Today, you can find more of his solo tracks as part of the SEB project.

About Moon Koradji Rec.

Independent psychedelic music label Moon Koradji Records was founded in Ukraine in 2007 by Oleksandr Nikiienko, aka DJ Omsun.
